name: Clean parcellations
summary: Removes unwanted or missing parcels from a volumetric parcellation and renumbers the remaining parcels consecutively, updating label.json, with nibabel and numpy; a parcellation utility.
description: Drops parcels listed in discard_labels plus any parcel present in the image but not in label.json (and vice versa), sets them to 0, renumbers the remaining parcels 1..N and writes a matching label.json. Use it before building networks or summary statistics so node lists match the image. The original key.txt is copied unchanged and does not reflect the renumbering.

inputs.description: Volumetric parcellation (parc.nii.gz) with its key.txt and label.json; label.json voxel_value entries define the valid parcels.

outputs.description: This parcellation will have missing and unwanted parcels removed from the parcellation. This will help with network generation and summary statistics

parameters.description: Space-separated voxel values (from label.json) of the parcels to remove, e.g. "1 181"; leave empty to only remove parcels missing from label.json or the image.

failure_modes.fix: Check that the parcellation has a label.json with voxel_value entries.
